title: Precision Through Play: Enhancing Fundamental Laparoscopic Skill Acquisition Via Gamified XR and Pseudo-Haptics
title_zh: 寓教于乐：通过游戏化XR和伪触觉增强腹腔镜基本技能获取
abstract: Extended Reality (XR) technologies have shown potential to improve laparoscopic skills acquisition. Among fundamental skills in laparoscopic surgery is accurate instrument handling. Appropriate instrument alignment and a perpendicular path ensure movement efficiency and improved performance. This work introduces an interactive XR platform designed to support an immersive, engaging, and accessible environment that facilitates continuous practice. This platform incorporates a gamification layer enriched by pseudo-haptics that generate a motivational feedback loop, allowing trainees to continuously practice instrument manipulation and angle control. The platform monitors instrument orientation, computes angular deviation from an ideal reference vector, and assigns scores based on user performance. A point-based scoring component reinforces correct technique and penalizes deviations in tool alignment beyond predefined thresholds. Furthermore, a pseudo-haptic feedback mechanism is integrated to provide real-time tactile feedback when deviation exceeds tolerance. Combined with low-cost hardware and accessible deployment, the framework aims to increase training scalability, engagement, and improve skill acquisition. Preliminary evaluations indicate that integrating gamified feedback significantly improves precision, reduces angular variance, and encourages sustained practice.
abstract_zh: 扩展现实（XR）技术已显示出改善腹腔镜技能获取的潜力。腹腔镜手术的基本技能之一是准确的器械操作。适当的器械对齐和垂直路径可确保运动效率并提高表现。本文介绍了一个交互式XR平台，旨在支持沉浸式、引人入胜且易于访问的环境，促进持续练习。该平台结合了游戏化层，并通过伪触觉增强，产生激励性反馈循环，使受训者能够持续练习器械操作和角度控制。平台监测器械方向，计算与理想参考向量的角度偏差，并根据用户表现分配分数。基于分数的评分组件强化正确技术，并对工具对齐超出预定义阈值的偏差进行惩罚。此外，集成了伪触觉反馈机制，当偏差超过容差时提供实时触觉反馈。结合低成本硬件和易于部署，该框架旨在提高训练可扩展性、参与度并改善技能获取。初步评估表明，整合游戏化反馈显著提高了精确度，减少了角度方差，并鼓励持续练习。
tldr_zh: 游戏化XR平台结合伪触觉反馈，提升腹腔镜器械操作精度与训练参与度。
cover_zh: 玩游戏也能练手术？XR加伪触觉让腹腔镜训练上瘾
